facts.statement: Morelladon lived in Spain during the Early Cretaceous, approximately 130 million years ago.
facts.quote: It lived during the Early Cretaceous of Spain, around 130 million years ago.

facts.statement: A euornithopod skeleton was discovered in 2013 by teams from UNED and the Universidad Autónoma de Madrid at the Mas de la Parreta quarry near Morella.
facts.quote: In 2013, teams of the Universidad Nacional de Educación a Distancia (UNED) and the Universidad Autónoma de Madrid, at the Mas de Sabaté (CMP-MS) site of the Mas de la Parreta quarry at Morella discovered a skeleton of a euornithopod.

facts.statement: The species Morelladon beltrani was named and described in 2015 by José Miguel Gasulla, Fernando Escaso, Iván Narváez, Francisco Ortega, and José Luis Sanz.
facts.quote: In 2015, the type species Morelladon beltrani was named and described by José Miguel Gasulla, Fernando Escaso, Iván Narváez, Francisco Ortega and José Luis Sanz.

facts.statement: The genus name Morelladon combines the location Morella with the Greek word for tooth.
facts.quote: The generic name combines a reference to Morella with Greek ὀδών, odṓn, "tooth".

facts.statement: The species name beltrani honors Victor Beltrán, the quarry owner who cooperated with the scientific research.
facts.quote: The specific name honours Victor Beltrán, the owner of the Vega del Moll S.A. Company exploiting the quarries, for his cooperation with the scientific research.

facts.statement: Morelladon is a medium-sized euornithopod estimated to be six meters long and weigh two tonnes.
facts.quote: Morelladon is a medium-sized euornithopod. Its body length has been estimated at six metres, its weight at two tonnes.

facts.statement: The rear middle back vertebrae have a depression that is 2.6 times higher than the length of its base.
facts.quote: The rear middle back vertebrae have a very high and deep depression between their rear articular processes and the base of the neural spine, 2.6 times higher than that base is long, measured from the front to the rear.

facts.statement: Morelladon belongs to the unranked family Iguanodontia.
The time range for Morelladon is the Barremian, from 125.77 to 121.4 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Barremian (125.77 to 121.4 million years ago)
